title: Print window: frustrating lack of parameter saving
summary: The print window does not save print settings/parameters for subsequent operations. Each time I open the window, I have to reconfigure the paper type (e.g., A4) and duplex settings. The paper type selection does not adhere to standard printer driver specifications; it fails to display the paper types actually supported by the printer driver—for instance, when using a 4 x 6-inch label printer.

title: Duplicating a doc with sub-docs is tedious
summary: ## Duplicating a doc with sub-docs: titles and icons are not preserved Follow-up to #2584 (duplicate with sub-docs). ### Problem User feedback after duplicating a doc together with its sub-docs: 1. **Every copied doc is renamed.** "Copy of" is added to the title of every doc in the copied tree, so users have to rename each sub-doc by hand. Untitled docs end up named just "Copy of". 2. **Icons stop working.** A doc's icon is the emoji at the start of its title. Adding "Copy of" in front pushes the emoji out of first place, so it shows as plain text instead of the doc icon. Users are left with a lot of manual work to get back an exact copy of the doc and its sub-docs. ### Proposal - **Only the top duplicated doc is marked as a copy.** Sub-docs keep their titles exactly as they were, icons included, it avoids manual work - **Mark the copy at the end of the title: `Roadmap (copy)`** instead of `Copy of Roadmap` to avoid removing the emoji - **If the duplicated doc has no title**, name the copy "Untitled document (copy)". This behaviour should apply also when a document is copied alone. #### Duplicating a doc with sub-docs | Original | Copy | |---|---| | Handbook | Handbook (copy) | | └ 🚀 Onboarding | └ 🚀 Onboarding | | └ *(untitled)* | └ *(untitled)* | #### Duplicating a single doc | Original | Copy | |---|---| | Roadmap | Roadmap (copy) | | 🚀 Roadmap | 🚀 Roadmap (copy) | | *(untitled)* | Untitled document (copy) | ### Longer term Storing the icon inside the title makes it fragile anywhere titles are changed or reused (duplication, export, search, mentions). A dedicated icon field on the document would avoid this kind of bug as it is stated here #1786
